title: setup hook --dry-run prints the diff of the new file and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `--dry-run` shows what would change and ends with `jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written`, exit 0, and writes nothing (not the file, not a backup folder). The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
